mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.flight_number, r.latitude, r.longitude, (select st_astext(r.geom)) as geom, r.flight_timestamp, r.flying_height, r.flight_model, r.no_use_data, r.azimuth, r.managerment_type, r.register_number, r.starting_place, r.destination_place, r.airline_belongs, r.other_info FROM flight_record_info_world r where r.flight_timestamp between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT r.id, r.flight_number, r.latitude, r.longitude, (select st_astext(r.geom)) as geom, r.flight_timestamp, r.flying_height, r.flight_model, r.no_use_data, r.azimuth, r.managerment_type, r.register_number, r.starting_place, r.destination_place, r.airline_belongs, r.other_info FROM flight_record_info_world r where st_contains(st_makepolygon(st_geomfromtext(#{bboxInfo})),geom)

SELECT r.id, r.flight_number, r.latitude, r.longitude, (select st_astext(r.geom)) as geom, r.flight_timestamp, r.flying_height, r.flight_model, r.no_use_data, r.azimuth, r.managerment_type, r.register_number, r.starting_place, r.destination_place, r.airline_belongs, r.other_info FROM flight_record_info_world r where st_contains(st_makepolygon(st_geomfromtext(#{bboxInfo})),geom) and r.flight_timestamp = #{date}

SELECT r.id, r.flight_number, r.latitude, r.longitude, (select st_astext(r.geom)) as geom, r.flight_timestamp, r.flying_height, r.flight_model, r.no_use_data, r.azimuth, r.managerment_type, r.register_number, r.starting_place, r.destination_place, r.airline_belongs, r.other_info FROM flight_record_info_world r where r.flight_number = #{flightNum}
